card: FinalizePSBT now verifies final scriptSig and scriptWitness data using PSBTInputSignedAndVerified before marking an input complete. Previously, inputs with a non_witness_utxo and existing final fields were trusted without script checks, causing finalizepsbt to return complete: true along with raw transaction hex that fails mempool verification. This aligns FinalizePSBT with fixes previously made to FillPSBT (#30357) and descriptorprocesspsbt (#33014). An intentional side effect is that inputs with consensus-valid but non-standard final scripts will now return complete: false.
evidence: PR description demonstrates reproduction: flipping a bit in the final witness of a P2WPKH PSBT causes finalizepsbt to output complete: true with a hex that testmempoolaccept rejects with 'mempool-script-verify-flag-failed (Signature must be zero for failed CHECK(MULTI)SIG operation)', while analyzepsbt marks the input not final
Author cites prior merged fixes applying the same check to other PSBT entry points: #30357 for FillPSBT and #33014 for descriptorprocesspsbt
problem: When a PSBT input has a non-witness UTXO and already contains final script fields, SignPSBTInput accepts them and ProduceSignature returns early before script verification. As a result, finalizepsbt can report complete: true and return a raw transaction hex whose script fails mempool verification, contradicting analyzepsbt which reports the input as not final.

risk.why: A flaw in final script verification could mistakenly reject valid PSBTs or block transaction finalization in RPC workflows.

scope_notes: Small logic change in FinalizePSBT with an added functional test and release note.
summary: Check PSBTInputSignedAndVerified for each input in FinalizePSBT before marking it complete. This prevents FinalizePSBT from unconditionally trusting pre-existing final scriptSig or scriptWitness fields without verifying them against standard execution flags.
